notes: Governmental funds on the modified cash basis (recorded as cash); proprietary funds (Electric, Water, Sewer) on the accrual basis, so business_type uses net position and the proprietary cash flow statement (p9) is recorded. Statement 'Taxes' 79,808 (p6) split using the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2): property 49,716 + motor vehicle 6,591 + sales 23,501 = 79,808 (ties to the fund schedules: General 41,626/6,591/18,807, Special Revenue sales 4,694, Debt Service property 8,090). Statement 'Intergovernmental revenues' 84,336 split to take out homestead allocation and motor vehicle prorate from the General Fund (p9) and Debt Service Fund (p13) schedules. Fire Fund debt payments (principal 1,325, interest 1,617) are printed under other financing sources (uses) below total expenditures: recorded as disbursements outside the printed total. Balance sheet: the governmental funds statement (193,387) does not equal the government-wide governmental column (842,481, includes capital assets and debt), so the Statement of Net Position Totals 2024 column is used. Detail: Schedules 1-4 per fund (nonmajor funds Fire, Landfill, Park, Auditorium, Senior Center per column); proprietary funds from Schedule 6 actual (accrual) column; nonoperating lines there are outside the operating totals. Schedule 5 (budget by fund group totals only, p14) not recorded to avoid double counting. Senior Center spending follows the statement (culture/recreation). Read pages 1-16 of 16.
